provenanceNote: Starting hypotheses written from public provider documentation and community experience — not benchmarked claims. PromptLoop refines these through your feedback, in your browser.

fields.instruction_style: Plain declarative instructions; XML-style tags (<context>, <task>) help separate long inputs
fields.reasoning_trigger: Adaptive reasoning is built in; explicit step-by-step helps only on multi-constraint tasks
fields.format_adherence: High — follows named sections and schemas closely
fields.verbosity_bias: Slightly verbose; cap lengths with numbers, not adjectives
fields.role_sensitivity: Specific personas noticeably shift tone and depth
fields.context_placement: Instructions first, long documents after; restate the ask after very long context

house_rules.text: Separate long inputs with simple tags like <context> and <task>
State output length caps in numbers (e.g. 'max 5 bullets'), not adjectives
Put hard constraints as a short bulleted list, not buried in prose

failure_modes: Adds hedges and caveats when constraints are vague
Over-explains simple answers unless told to be brief
